notes.title: Build 0.5.0-1
notes.content:
Build 0.5.0-1: May 11 2021
"Smol Hotfix"

[CHANGE] Tooltip for farming plants break down base plant power, plant power buff, and total plant power now.
[CHANGE] Buffed MM2 jello costs moderately, and dice cost juust a bit.

[BUGFIX] MM 4 cost was missing a digit. oops
[BUGFIX] Couple issues with farming upgrades not showing in the stat breakdowns.

notes.title: Build 0.5.0 out now!
notes.content:
Build 0.5.0: May 9 2021
"Tons of New Stuff!"

[ADDED] Added Map 5!
[ADDED] Added 27 new buildings to unlock!
[ADDED] Added dozens of research and work order upgrades!
[ADDED] Added 8 new relics!
[ADDED] Added farming upgrade menu to spend your hard earned harvests in! Over 100 upgrades!
[ADDED] 2 New plants!
[ADDED] A New Special Encounter!
[ADDED] A bunch of new base decorations!


[ADDED] Timescale view mode that uses your buffer threshold setting as the unit of time.


[CHANGE] Some Juices have slightly updates sprites to make each tier visually distinct.
[CHANGE] elementium gain doesn't impact cost of breakthroughs anymore.
[CHANGE] Because of ^^^, nerfed the Elementium gain relic.
[CHANGE] Base decorations can be placed further off the screen, to allow more creativity.

[BUGFIXES] Plant power and Breed Power didn't apply correctly to some plant types.
[BUGFIXES] Breakthrough paging was scuffed. Now it aint'.
[BUGFIXES] Wokr Orders "have:" amount now update in real time
[BUGFIXES] blueprints with blank names now properly use the name of an building applied, if used


that's it. that's the announcement. go play!

-4G

notes.title: Build 0.4.10-2
notes.content:
Build 0.4.10-2: April 17 2020
"Random Additions!"

[ADDED] New Colours added to gain/loss display, along with a setting. 
If production is negative stocks will last longer than the specified time, gain/loss will be in yellow, otherwise orange.
If you have <30s of stocks remaining, number will be red like before.

[ADDED] A bunch of new pit perks, extending up to 1800 PP!
[ADDED] The Fine.

[BUGFIXES] Tile tooltip offset from mouse on higher resolutions cause it to fall off-screen.
[BUGFIXES] Some Pit Perk buffs didn't work. Now they do.
[BUGFIXES] Fixed one trillion typos.
[BUGFIXES] Ascended Newbie Pack didn't award poop properly.

[CHANGE] Work Orders show how much of a given material you currently have.
[CHANGE] When loading a save file, the ISOPOD will start using the last floor you selected.
[CHANGE] Work Order material tooltip removed since all the info is now on the pod directly.
